title: Andean Passes Database (APD v1.0): code, derived data and supplementary material
description: Code, derived data, figures and supplementary tables for the article 'Climatic Permeability of Andean Mountain passes: a continental census under present and future climates'. Census of every col along the Pacific-Atlantic drainage divide of the Andes (11°N-55°S) from Copernicus GLO-30 by marker-controlled priority flooding; crest-flank thermal overlap and moisture gaps (WorldClim 2.1, Global Aridity Index v3.1, MODIS cloud frequency); test of Janzen's prediction; projections with eight CMIP6 models under three scenarios; montane corridor, protection and human modification. The code is under MIT; data, figures and tables follow LICENSE-DATA.md, with non-commercial terms for files derived from WorldClim, EarthEnv and the WDPA.
